description: action pause or stop takes effect after the batches running now (a queued batch is cancelled and refunded); resume carries on.

campaign_id.description: An id from run_advanced_search or list_advanced_searches.

name: control_advanced_search

estimate.description: { expected_leads, low, high, minutes } as estimated when it started.
